claims.statement: Pinned single-select guide covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and describes one selected option with label, description and color. Presentation is not validated policy strength, operational state or completion attestation.

Field-qualified option filters support comma-separated multiple values; a single-select item value and multi-value filter are distinct. Full matching/case/escaping and permission behavior require separately reviewed filter semantics.
Pinned source limits single-select fields to 50 options. This historical limit is not current entitlement verification, a generalized universal threshold or permission to remove existing options.

Creation uses new-field table menu, name, Single select, initial option and Add option then Save. Source does not specify duplicate labels, stable option ID preservation or exhaustive role permissions.

Default must be an existing option and prepopulates newly added items; deselecting default and saving leaves existing items unchanged. No historical backfill or value overwrite guarantee demonstrated.

Editing modal changes option label and optionally color/description, then Save. Name-based filters and Actions option matching require dependency review; source does not establish ID changes or reproduced failure from renaming.
This guide does not describe option deletion, effect on assigned items, undo or recovery. No deletion semantics inferred from absent procedure; proposed lifecycle audit remains unfinished.

New-field reusable is navigational; API option IDs and reviewed Actions exact-name lookup are distinct integration evidence. No fields/options/defaults changed, accepted policy, rights clearance or native receipt.
